templates.name: Print-Ready Preflight
templates.description: Preflight checklist for print production files
templates.content:
# Print-Ready Preflight

## Project
<!-- Project name -->

## Document Setup
- [ ] Correct trim size
- [ ] Bleed: 0.125" / 3mm
- [ ] Safe zone: 0.25" / 6mm from trim
- [ ] Color mode: CMYK

## Images
- [ ] All images 300 dpi minimum
- [ ] No RGB images
- [ ] No upscaled images
- [ ] Linked files collected

## Typography
- [ ] All fonts outlined or embedded
- [ ] No missing fonts
- [ ] Minimum text size: 6pt
- [ ] Rich black for large text: C40 M30 Y30 K100

## Colors
- [ ] Spot colors specified correctly
- [ ] No unintended spot colors
- [ ] Total ink coverage < 300%

## Export
- [ ] PDF/X-1a or PDF/X-4
- [ ] Crop marks and bleed marks
- [ ] Color bars included
